correctness.rationale: Symmetric averaging is licensed by concavity of the spectral gap. The invariant-subspace diagonalization is exact, with center/leaf antisymmetric matrix A, leaf-difference matrix C and 0,n eigenvalues. Strict concavity of the A lower eigenvalue, strict increase of the C lower eigenvalue and a characteristic-polynomial sign identity prove the two exact transitions. An independent averaged Rayleigh bound over arbitrary nonuniform leaf weights proves the globally unique hub-extinction regime; the uniform Rayleigh equality proves initial global uniqueness. Rational characteristic identities and full Laplacian spectra passed 707 finite checks in verify_multiplex.py. Finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: This is a complete all-budget classification for a natural heterogeneous one-to-one coupled network already motivated in optimization literature. The independently derived second phase boundary and forced high-budget deletion of an available hub-matching link are structural design phenomena, not a routine restatement of the known low-budget inequality. The sharp n=3 exception and global high-phase rigidity add substantive insight; the theorem makes no unsupported performance claim.
